title: Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta and Oracle Expect a Negative Cash Flow of $125 Billion Next Year - Slashdot
excerpt: The Washington Post shared surprising news this week about five top AI companies. content_html:
The Washington Post shared surprising news this week about five top AI companies.

Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta and Oracle "are spending so much on developing AI and delivering it to customers that they're expected to bleed cash in the coming year, according to a Washington Post analysis of data compiled by S&P Global Market Intelligence." Free cash flow, which measures the cash left over after paying expenses and AI infrastructure costs, is now expected to shrink to almost nothing for the five companies combined in 2026, and decline again to negative $125 billion the following year... AI spending by Amazon and Google pushed the companies to an ignominious milestone: They lost more cash in the past three months than any other large U.S. companies, according to S&P Global data. Investment analysts expect Elon Musk's SpaceX to show even worse cash bleeding this week.

content_html_zh:
《华盛顿邮报》本周分享了有关五家顶级人工智能公司的令人惊讶的消息。

微软、谷歌、亚马逊、Meta 和甲骨文“在开发人工智能并将其交付给客户方面投入了大量资金，根据《华盛顿邮报》对标准普尔全球市场情报公司汇编的数据进行的分析，预计它们将在来年大量亏损。” 自由现金流（衡量支付费用和人工智能基础设施成本后剩余的现金）目前预计到 2026 年这五家公司的总和将缩减至几乎为零，并在次年再次下降至负 1250 亿美元…… 亚马逊和谷歌的人工智能支出将这两家公司推向了一个不光彩的里程碑：根据标准普尔全球数据，它们在过去三个月中损失的现金比任何其他美国大型公司都多。 投资分析师预计埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 本周将出现更严重的现金流失。
